title: Qinux package profile
description: A named set of packages forming one installable component. Files in profiles/ validate against this schema.

$comment.description: Note for humans and generators. Validators ignore it.

name.description: Profile identifier. Must match the filename.

description.description: One sentence, shown to the user during installation.

inherits.description: Another profile to extend. Resolved when the index is generated.

groups.description: Package groups this profile includes. Groups are how most packages are named.

packages.description: Individual packages. Only for components that genuinely are one package.

optional.description: Packages offered during installation but not installed by default.

conflicts.description: Packages or groups that must not be installed alongside this profile.

display_manager.description: Display manager this profile enables, if any.

size_hint.description: Approximate installed size in megabytes, for the installer to show.
